UNITED STATES
NUCLEAR REGULATORY COMMISSION
WASHINGTON, D. C. 20666
JUL 7 1977
1.151/
Mr. Marvin Siflinger
Acting Area Office Director
ATTN: Environmental Clearance Officer
Department of Housing and Urban
Development
15 New Chardon Street
Boston, Massachusetts 02114
Dear Mr. Siflinger:
This is in response to your request for comments on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project in Cambridge, Massachusetts (HUD Project No. R-108).
We have reviewed the statement and determined that the proposed action has no significant radiological health and safety impacts nor will it adversely affect any activities subject to regulation by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Accordingly, we have no substantive comments to make.
Thank you for providing us with the opportunity to review the sender Square Urban Renewal Project Draft Environmental Impact Statement.
Sincerely,
Voss A. Moore, Assistant Tirector
Division of Site Safety and Environmental Analysis
cc: CEQ (5)
